routes.name: R_CH_FINITE_ONLY
routes.retired_because: Finite scans do not cover actual coding, arbitrary construction depth, or the analytic window hypotheses.

C9000323.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 323 (Independence of the separable quotient problem.; papers: Relative independence of the separable quotient problem; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/323.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_CH_EST.statement: Under the actual parameter, block-window and thinning hypotheses, every finite pure or mixed norming expression satisfies sum_i |f(x_i)| <= (2112/7) L_J/m_J, independently of construction depth.

C_CH_STRONG.statement: For every actual finite pure or mixed expression satisfying the manuscript hypotheses, at arbitrary construction depth, sum_i |f(x_i)| <= (1794/7) L_J/m_J.

C_CH_CROP.statement: A product-convex crop in any collection of coherently ordered attributes has at most two partial block hits, giving six marked columns per path in the actual pure and mixed families.

C_CH_LOCAL.statement: Actual cropped operations admit the eight-mark, column-duality, boundary-incidence and disjoint-within-weight singleton decomposition for arbitrary assigned block subsets.

C_CH_TRANSFER.statement: Support-preserving grouped recursion permits overlap across weights and obeys the geometric small-charge and finite-node large-charge bounds at every depth.

C_CH_KERNEL.statement: For arbitrary finite real coordinate spaces and finite exponents p>=1, disjoint-within-group weighted recombination obeys the lp contraction, support is preserved, and the geometric and charge-tree bounds hold for every natural depth.

C_CH_WINDOWS.statement: The requisite windows and thinning can be realized in every prescribed admissible block tail.

C_CH_PARTITION.statement: Manuscript pair:partition supplies finite unit blocks with interval partition bound 8 d^(1/r).

C_CH_WEAK_CAUCHY.statement: Manuscript path:weak-cauchy supplies weak-Cauchy subsequences. Its compact-closure analysis remains an unresolved analytic prerequisite here.

C_CH_FOUR_HITS.statement: Manuscript pair:four-hits supplies the uncropped-path thinning from weak nullity and coherence.

C_CH_PAIR.statement: The universal estimate, together with the explicitly unresolved window-existence prerequisite and norm/crop properties, implies Proposition pair:exact.

C_CH_NEGATIVE.statement: CH implies failure of the real and complex separable quotient assertions. Pair existence is one dependency; the remaining branch and predual arguments are not certified by this mission.

C_RVM_POSITIVE.statement: A real-valued measurable continuum implies the real and complex separable quotient assertions; outside this mission.
